verdict.rationale: The evidence pack never documents a data-export capability, such as exporting workflow histories or namespace data in open formats or migrating off Temporal Cloud. Self-hostable open-source infrastructure, CLI access, and client APIs like 'List Workflow Executions' are adjacent building blocks or deployment options, not a documented export-and-leave feature.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave
